description: Mirror elements (ids) across a vertical plane through a line from start to end (plan mm), or flip them in place through their middle along axis red (east–west), green (north–south) or blue (upside down: shapes and models only). copy keeps the originals and mirrors copies. Walls, slabs, roofs, stairs, ramps and beams are rebuilt mirrored, doors and windows change hand, and a stair turns the other way. One undo step; returns the mirrored ids (the copies with copy).

axis.description: Flip in place instead of mirroring across start–end

end.description: Plan point in mm (x east, y north), relative to its level

start.description: Plan point in mm (x east, y north), relative to its level

name: mirror
title: Mirror or flip elements
